fai_configdir.description: Root directory containing all FAI configuration files (classes, hooks, disk config, etc.)

fai_logdir.description: Directory where FAI logs are stored after client installations

fai_softwaredir.description: Directory containing scripts, package lists, and other runtime software for installations

fai_debian_release.description: Debian release codename used as the default target distribution for installations

fai_debug.description: Debug verbosity level: 0 = normal, 1 = verbose, 2 = debug

fai_verbose.description: Enable detailed logging to console and logs during installation

fai_nfs_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for NFS mounts (e.g., for /usr or /home) during installation

default_partitioning.description: Name of the disk partitioning file (without extension) to use by default (found in $FAI_CONFIGDIR/disk_config/)

default_fs_type.description: Default filesystem type for partitions that don’t specify one explicitly

items.description: Name of a Debian package to install by default on all target hosts

default_packages.description: List of packages installed on every host (in addition to class-specific packages)

fai_install_packages.description: Whether to install packages during the FAI installation (set to false for minimal installs or post-install setup)

fai_create_users.description: Whether to create local user accounts (defined in $FAI_CONFIGDIR/classes/) during installation

fai_run_hooks.description: Whether to execute custom hook scripts defined per class

fai_ipmi.description: Enable IPMI support for remote power control (e.g., to reboot unresponsive hosts)

fai_pxe_chainload.description: Enable chainloading of alternative bootloaders (e.g., for UEFI-to-legacy fallback)

bootmenu_timeout.description: Time in deciseconds (1/10 second) to show PXE boot menu before auto-booting

items.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of a DNS server

nameservers.description: DNS servers configured in /etc/resolv.conf of target systems

ntpserver.description: Default NTP server used to synchronize time on target systems

default_gateway.description: Default gateway IP address for target systems (leave empty to skip configuration)

default_netmask.description: Default netmask used when no per-interface netmask is specified

host_suffix.description: Suffix appended to the short hostname to form the FQDN (e.g., '.example.com')

fai_ipv6.description: Whether to enable and configure IPv6 on target systems

default.name: DEBIAN
default.comment: Base class for all Debian-based clients

items.description: A class definition used to group configuration and behavior

priority.description: Priority (higher = evaluated last, overrides earlier classes)

items.description: Package name to install only when this class is active

packages.description: Additional packages to install when this class is selected

packages_comment.description: Optional comment above the class-specific package list

items.description: Shell command to execute when this class is active (typically from hooks/)

hooks.description: Commands/scripts to run during the class phase

hooks_comment.description: Optional comment above the class-specific hooks

classes.description: List of FAI classes — each defines conditions and behavior to apply selectively to target hosts
